evidence.quote: We propose a $36 million class fund distributed automatically to the approximately 400,000 identifiable members, plus up to $7 million in court-approved fees and expenses.

evidence.agent: Hargrove Lane LLP declaration to court
evidence.quote: The parties discussed class relief and fees together; class relief was not agreed upon before fees were discussed.

summary: Plaintiff raised fees in its opening proposal together with the class fund. The transcript and declaration state that class relief and fees were discussed together before class relief was settled. There is no clear evidence of a tradeoff between fees and class recovery, plaintiff self-dealing, defense exploitation of fee interests, reverse-auction tactics, or a misleading declaration.
